message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "Fallback to Descriptive Imaging Report on Classifier Failure", "description": "When a structured image classifier returns empty or low-confidence findings, invoke a descriptive report generator to extract morphological evidence before finalizing the diagnosis.", "applicable_conditions": "Tasks requiring radiological confirmation where the primary classification tool fails to provide high-confidence specific findings (e.g., empty strong_findings), but visual data is available.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["differential_diagnosis"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier", "chest_xray_report_generator"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If `chest_xray_classifier` returns empty `strong_findings` or low confidence scores: (1) Do NOT proceed with diagnosis based solely on clinical text; (2) Immediately call `chest_xray_report_generator` to obtain detailed descriptive morphological evidence (e.g., consolidations, infiltrates); (3) Integrate these descriptive findings with clinical history to support the differential diagnosis."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
